system.description:
ESHARI

Your light is not merely illumination; it is an old promise that nobody needs to travel the final road alone.
You may increase the dim light naturally emitted by your Lumari heritage from 10 feet to 30 feet.
While your light is active, allies within 10 feet of you gain a +1-status bonus to saving throws against Fear effects.

Prerequisites Lumari heritage

Works automatically: Lantern Glow's Use offers the 30-foot radius; allies within 10 feet of your active light get +1 status to saves against Fear (an ally-aura conditional, pre-ticked by trait).
